$comment: Minimal spec on purpose. `groups` is optional, and design-artifacts.yml passes `modules: all`, so the published inventory is discovered from every module that applies the composeAiPreview plugin rather than hand-listed here. That gets a catalog online against the previews Horologist already renders in CI; a curated sticker sheet — named groups, sections, captions, variants — can be layered on later without changing the delivery contract.
